item.title: ASML afirma que demanda por IA excederá capacidade das máquinas para fabricação de chips até 2028
item.description: A ASML afirmou que a crescente demanda por IA está impulsionando os pedidos de seus equipamentos para fabricação de chips até 2030, com os clientes buscando mais capacidade do que a empresa pode fornecer no próximo ano e até 2028, o que aumenta as preocupações com a escassez de oferta.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A ASML (ASML.AS) afirmou que a crescente demanda por IA está impulsionando os pedidos de seus equipamentos para fabricação de chips até 2030, com os clientes buscando mais capacidade do que a empresa pode fornecer no próximo ano e até 2028, o que aumenta as preocupações com a escassez de oferta. Os clientes já estão discutindo pedidos para além de 2027, com alguns manifestando interesse em reservar capacidade para 2029 e 2030, informou a empresa holandesa nesta quarta-feira. A demanda pelas máquinas da empresa tem sido impulsionada pelo boom da IA e pela rápida expansão dos data centers, com clientes como a TSMC (2330.TW) — que fabrica chips para a Nvidia (NVDA.O) —, bem como a Samsung (005930.KS) e a Intel (INTC.O) , investindo pesadamente para aumentar a produção de chips. As ações da ASML subiram quase 70% este ano. A ASML, líder no mercado de equipamentos utilizados na fabricação dos chips mais avançados, afirmou que está buscando maneiras de expandir ainda mais sua capacidade. Em julho, a ASML anunciou que aumentaria a capacidade em 30% em 2027 e, novamente, em 30% em 2028, mas o presidente-executivo Christophe Fouquet afirmou que estava claro que isso não seria suficiente. Fouquet disse que a empresa está observando agora “um grande volume de pedidos para 2028. Mas também um forte interesse em já fazer pedidos para 2029 e, às vezes, até mesmo para 2030”. MELHORIA NAS PERSPECTIVAS DE VENDAS As declarações da empresa foram feitas no momento em que ela divulgou seus resultados trimestrais e uma perspectiva de vendas mais otimista, o que levou a empresa a elevar o limite inferior de sua previsão de vendas para o ano inteiro. A ASML agora espera vendas no quarto trimestre entre 14,2 bilhões de euros e 15,2 bilhões de euros (US$15,9 bilhões a US$17 bilhões), acima das previsões dos analistas, com uma margem bruta de cerca de 57%. Isso, por sua vez, elevou sua previsão de vendas para o ano inteiro para 44 bilhões de euros a 45 bilhões de euros. As ações da ASML, que tem um valor de mercado de cerca de 586 bilhões de euros, subiam quase 3% no início do pregão em Amsterdã. CORRIDA PARA AMPLIAR A CAPACIDADE A ASML deu início, no mês passado, a uma grande expansão em Eindhoven, na Holanda, mas precisará buscar outras formas de lidar com a capacidade antes que a primeira fase seja concluída em 2029. Dassen disse que a ASML também lidará com a escassez atualizando as ferramentas existentes e vendendo novas versões de suas máquinas com maior rendimento. Em conjunto, essas medidas proporcionariam “um aumento significativo na capacidade de nossos clientes”, disse ele, observando que a empresa aumentará os preços a partir de 2027, com o efeito total visível a partir de 2028. No terceiro trimestre, a ASML registrou lucro líquido de 4,96 bilhões de euros sobre faturamento líquido de 11,7 bilhões de euros, acima dos 4,05 bilhões de euros e em linha com as expectativas dos analistas consultados pela LSEG. (Reportagem de Toby Sterling em Amsterdã e Nathan Vifflin em Gdansk)

item.title: SPD-Politiker: "Bauchschmerzen" gegenüber Links-Koalition in Berlin bestätigt
item.description: Der SPD-Politiker Dirk Wiese hat sich sehr kritisch zu den Sondierungsgesprächen von Linkspartei, SPD und Grünen in Berlin geäußert. Seine "Bauchschmerzen" hätten sich bestätigt, sagte der parlamentarische Geschäftsführer der SPD-Bundestagsfraktion am Mittwoch in Berlin. "Ich kann es nicht nachvollziehen, dass die Linkspartei es nicht schafft, einen klaren Schlussstrich unter den Abgeordneten Ferhat Kocak zu ziehen", fügte er mit Blick auf den Linken-Bundestagsabgeordneten und dessen mutmaßliche Kontakte zur organisierten Kriminalität. Zudem könnten sich große Teile der Linkspartei nicht einmal hinter einer Erklärung von Linken, SPD und Grünen gegen Antisemitismus versammeln, die eigentlich nur Selbstverständlichkeiten enthalte. "Ich fand es erst mal richtig, dass man die Sondierungen jetzt unterbrochen hat", sagte er mit Blick auf eine entsprechende Erklärung von SPD und Grünen vom Dienstag. Die Linkspartei habe "erheblichste Baustellen im eigenen Laden". Wie sie damit umgehe, müsse man nun abwarten.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der SPD-Politiker Dirk Wiese hat sich sehr kritisch zu den Sondierungsgesprächen von Linkspartei, SPD und Grünen in Berlin geäußert. Seine "Bauchschmerzen" hätten sich bestätigt, sagte der parlamentarische Geschäftsführer der SPD-Bundestagsfraktion am Mittwoch in Berlin. "Ich kann es nicht nachvollziehen, dass die Linkspartei es nicht schafft, einen klaren Schlussstrich unter den Abgeordneten Ferhat Kocak zu ziehen", fügte er mit Blick auf den Linken-Bundestagsabgeordneten und dessen mutmaßliche Kontakte zur organisierten Kriminalität. Zudem könnten sich große Teile der Linkspartei nicht einmal hinter einer Erklärung von Linken, SPD und Grünen gegen Antisemitismus versammeln, die eigentlich nur Selbstverständlichkeiten enthalte. "Ich fand es erst mal richtig, dass man die Sondierungen jetzt unterbrochen hat", sagte er mit Blick auf eine entsprechende Erklärung von SPD und Grünen vom Dienstag. Die Linkspartei habe "erheblichste Baustellen im eigenen Laden". Wie sie damit umgehe, müsse man nun abwarten. Wiese kritisierte aber auch, dass der CDU-Spitzenkandidat Stefan Evers nicht seinerseits SPD und Grüne zu einem Kaffee eingeladen habe. Vielleicht wäre dies eine Idee, sagte der SPD-Politiker in Anspielung darauf, dass CDU, SPD und Grüne die Mehrheit für eine sogenannte Kenia-Koalition in Berlin hätten. CSU-Landesgruppenchef Alexander Hoffmann forderte SPD und Grüne gegenüber den TV-Sendern RTL/ntv auf, die Sondierungen mit der Linken in Berlin vollständig zu beenden.

item.title: スペースＸ、スターリンク一部制限 ウクライナ軍に支障＝当局者
item.description:
Yuliia Dysa
[キーウ １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Yuliia Dysa

[キーウ　１４日 ロイター] - スペースＸがウクライナで衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の一部を制限した。このためスターリンクが欠かせない無人機（ドローン）の戦闘任務に支障が出ている。ウクライナ当局者らが１４日、明らかにした。

ベスクレストノフ大統領顧問はメッセージアプリ「テレグラム」に「わが国の防衛部隊はこの制限について事前に通知を受けておらず、複数の任務に支障が出た」と投稿した。

同氏によると、スペースＸは軍用仕様のスターリンクについて、速度が時速１００マイル（１６０キロ）を超えるとサービスが利用できないようにした。

南東部に展開するウクライナ軍の第７即応軍団も、一部の任務を中止せざるを得なくなったと明らかにした。ロイターへの声明で「われわれが確認したところ、飛行中は時速１１０─１２０キロでも１０─２０秒間、接続が途切れることがあった。ドローンは飛び続けたものの、その影響で操縦が難しくなった」と説明した。

ウクライナ国防省筋もこの制限で補給や一部のドローン作戦が著しく困難になっていると述べた。

スペースＸにコメントを求めたが、現時点で回答は得られていない。

スターリンクのサービスが制限された理由は明らかではない。ただウクライナはロシアの製油所への攻撃を停止するよう米国から圧力を受けている。

スターリンクはロシア国内では利用できず、ロシアの石油産業を攻撃するウクライナのドローンは別の通信手段を使っている。

item.title: Google abre su Play Store a aplicaciones creadas con IA para uso personal
item.description: La compañía permitirá publicar en la tienda aplicaciones para Android creadas con Google AI Studio sin pagar una cuenta de desarrollador.
item.dc:creator: Natalie Lung
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Google, filial de Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), está facilitando a los usuarios de Android la ejecución de aplicaciones programadas con Vibe para uso personal, lo que reduce las barreras para los consumidores sin conocimientos técnicos que recurren cada vez más a la inteligencia artificial para crear herramientas que se adapten a sus propias necesidades. A partir del martes, las personas mayores de 18 años que dispongan de una cuenta de Google podrán publicar en la Play Store aplicaciones para Android creadas a través de Google AI Studio, una plataforma web destinada a la creación de prototipos de aplicaciones y a la generación de contenidos multimedia utilizando los diversos modelos de inteligencia artificial del gigante tecnológico. Ver más: Google lanza Fitbit Edge, la pulsera fitness de pantalla ovalada y batería que dura hasta una semana Cabe destacar que esta nueva medida incluye incluso a quienes no disponen de una cuenta de desarrollador de pago, lo que abre la Play Store a los denominados “programadores por intuición”, cualquier persona que utilice lenguaje natural para pedir a la IA que genere código de software. Hay algunas salvedades: estas aplicaciones aparecerán en la lista privada, lo que significa que son para uso personal y no serán visibles en la búsqueda universal ni en las recomendaciones de la tienda. La integración tampoco está disponible con Antigravity, la otra plataforma de desarrollo de software impulsada por IA de Google. Estos cambios ofrecen a los usuarios de Google una forma gratuita de experimentar y lanzar aplicaciones móviles en la era de la IA generativa. Hasta ahora, los aspirantes a desarrolladores de aplicaciones se enfrentaban a mayores obstáculos. Google cobra una cuota única de registro de US$25 por las cuentas de desarrollador, tarda varios días en revisar las aplicaciones recién enviadas y obtiene una comisión si los desarrolladores cobran por los servicios digitales dentro de la aplicación. La App Store de Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) exige US$99 al año por su programa para desarrolladores. Ver más: Google y Unity presentan Playground, una plataforma para crear videojuegos con IA sin programar Google tiene previsto permitir, con el tiempo, que los programadores aficionados compartan su aplicación personal con un pequeño grupo de usuarios, como amigos y familiares, según ha declarado Sam Bright, vicepresidente y director general de Google Play y del ecosistema de desarrolladores. Google también está limitando, en un primer momento, los servicios dentro de la aplicación por los que estos desarrolladores pueden cobrar, añadió. Durante una rueda de prensa previa al anuncio, Bright presentó un ejemplo de creación de una aplicación de seguimiento personalizada para el equipo deportivo local de sus hijos, con el fin de coordinar el dinero de las camisetas, los honorarios de los árbitros y los gastos de la pizza tras los partidos entre 15 familias. Google presentó la herramienta AI Studio en 2023 para que los usuarios pudieran probar sus últimos modelos de IA para la programación y la generación de imágenes y audio en un navegador web, sin necesidad de configurar sus propios dispositivos. En su conferencia de desarrolladores I/O celebrada este mes de mayo, Google simplificó el proceso para que los programadores pudieran crear y probar aplicaciones de Android dentro de la herramienta. Google ha venido ofreciendo a los consumidores otras formas de personalizar sus dispositivos mediante la IA. En mayo, la empresa comenzó a permitir a los propietarios de dispositivos Android utilizar Gemini para crear widgets personalizados para la pantalla de inicio. Ver más: Google lanza agente Gemini “universal” que funciona en Gmail, Drive, Docs y Calendar: ¿cómo funciona? Aunque los desarrolladores y los usuarios siempre han podido instalar aplicaciones de diversas fuentes en dispositivos Android sin pasar por la Play Store, Bright señaló que Google AI Studio cuenta con controles de seguridad integrados que garantizan que las aplicaciones personales que lleguen a la Play Store no contengan contenido dañino o inapropiado. Bright añadió que los cambios optimizarán la experiencia de las personas sin conocimientos técnicos “que se están iniciando en la creación de aplicaciones por primera vez”, ofreciéndoles “la máxima flexibilidad” para decidir cómo desean ampliar la audiencia de su aplicación con el paso del tiempo. “El futuro de las aplicaciones en Google Play es personal, seguro y creado por todos”, afirmó Bright. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Yemen fighting overwhelms hospitals, cuts aid to 800,000 people, relief agencies say
item.description: Hospitals across Yemen are struggling to cope with a sharp rise in war casualties, while intensified fighting along multiple front lines has cut off aid to around 800,000 people, humanitarian agencies said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Le Poidevin
item.content:encoded: Hospitals across Yemen are struggling to cope with a sharp rise in war casualties, while intensified fighting along multiple front lines has cut off aid to around 800,000 people, humanitarian agencies said on Wednesday. Front-line hospitals in areas including Marib, [USN:L1N45Z0S1 TEXT:"Taiz"] and Yemen's Red Sea coast are seeing unprecedented numbers of weapon-wounded patients, with some facilities admitting more than 700 casualties in a single week, according to the Red Cross. More than [USN:L6N45T0PA TEXT:"200,000 people have been displaced"] from their homes since fighting in the country began in recent weeks, sparked by renewed fighting between the Iran-backed Houthi group and Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen, according to the United Nations' International Organization for Migration. "Trauma care staff are under enormous pressure," ICRC health coordinator Feras Abusamra said in a statement. Only a small proportion of Yemen's functioning health facilities are capable of providing comprehensive trauma care, he said, while hospitals face large numbers of wounded people amid shortages of surgical supplies, anesthesia, oxygen and medicines. Yemen's health services, battered by more than a decade of conflict, economic crisis, displacement and disease outbreaks, may have limited capacity to absorb a new surge in mass casualties if fighting intensifies further, the ICRC warned. The fighting has also cut off life-saving humanitarian assistance for 800,000 people in Taiz - Yemen's third-largest city, which currently hosts the largest number of people fleeing the fighting - and other areas impacted by the conflict, the UN World Food Programme said on Wednesday. Some districts are now inaccessible because of fighting and road closures, the WFP said, adding that wheat flour stocks are nearly exhausted and remaining food in local markets may last only a short time. "This is the kind of situation that can rapidly spiral into a humanitarian catastrophe if assistance cannot move safely and reach those who need it most," said El-Khidir Daloum, WFP Representative and Country Director in Yemen, in a statement.

item.title: La Fiscalía de Turquía nombra un administrador gubernamental para Halk TV, afín a la oposición
item.description: Las autoridades turcas nombraron a un administrador gubernamental para dirigir la cadena de televisión Halk TV, afín a la oposición, informó el miércoles la Fiscalía, mientras la policía registraba sus oficinas en Estambul en un caso que ha reavivado la preocupación por la libertad de prensa en el país.
item.dc:creator: Tuvan Gumrukcu
item.content:encoded: Las autoridades turcas nombraron a un administrador gubernamental para dirigir la cadena de televisión Halk TV, afín a la oposición, informó el miércoles la Fiscalía, mientras la policía registraba sus oficinas en Estambul en un caso que ha reavivado la preocupación por la libertad de prensa en el país. La Fiscalía General de Estambul dijo que su unidad de delitos financieros había investigado al presidente de Halk TV, Cafer Mahiroglu, por "soborno, amaño de licitaciones y blanqueo de activos procedentes de delitos", y añadió que las pruebas, las declaraciones de testigos y los registros de transacciones mostraban actividad delictiva. La Fiscalía indicó en un comunicado que había emitido órdenes de detención contra 17 personas, entre ellas Mahiroglu, y que 11 habían sido detenidas. Las empresas en las que Mahiroglu es socio o administrador han sido intervenidas y el Fondo de Seguro de Depósitos de Ahorro (TMSF, por sus siglas en turco) ha sido nombrado administrador, añadió. Mahiroglu, que se encuentra fuera de Turquía, es buscado por las autoridades. "Cientos de policías han entrado en el edificio. No se permite el acceso al edificio de Halk TV mientras se lleva a cabo un registro en su interior", dijo la cadena en su sitio web. La emisión en directo de la cadena fue interrumpida a las 6:30 hora local (0330 GMT), tras lo cual comenzaron a emitirse contenidos pregrabados. Deniz Bayramoglu, responsable de un programa de Halk TV, dijo en la red social X que el director editorial, Suat Toktas, había intentado convencer al jefe de la delegación del administrador de que permitiera continuar la emisión, pero no se lo autorizaron. La medida convierte a Halk TV en el quinto gran medio informativo turco al que se le nombra un administrador, después de decisiones judiciales similares que afectaron a Flash TV, Eko Turk, Haberturk y Tele1. El Gobierno ha recurrido con frecuencia en los últimos años al nombramiento de administradores para asumir la gestión de municipios o intervenir empresas. Desde hace tiempo designa administradores políticos para hacerse cargo de municipios del sureste de Turquía, destituyendo a alcaldes electos de un partido opositor prokurdo.

item.title: Rusia detiene a un periodista japonés bajo sospecha de espionaje
item.description: Rusia dijo el martes que había detenido a un periodista japonés bajo sospecha de espionaje y acusó a Tokio de utilizar a corresponsales de medios de comunicación para recabar información de inteligencia, lo que marca un nuevo mínimo en unas relaciones bilaterales que se han deteriorado considerablemente en los últimos meses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rusia dijo el martes que había detenido a un periodista japonés bajo sospecha de espionaje y acusó a Tokio de utilizar a corresponsales de medios de comunicación para recabar información de inteligencia, lo que marca un nuevo mínimo en unas relaciones bilaterales que se han deteriorado considerablemente en los últimos meses. El Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores ruso identificó al periodista como Yuki Imai y el Servicio Federal de Seguridad (FSB, por sus siglas en ruso) dijo que trabajaba para Hokkaido Shimbun, un periódico regional de la isla septentrional japonesa de Hokkaido. Fue detenido en la región de Sajalín, en el extremo oriental de Rusia, el día antes de que tuviera previsto abandonar el país, dijo el FSB, sin precisar la fecha. Lo acusó de recopilar y almacenar, con fines de inteligencia, información sobre las capacidades de defensa de Rusia que, según el organismo, podría utilizarse contra la seguridad del país. Hokkaido Shimbun no confirmó la identidad del periodista y se limitó a decir que aún estaba verificando los detalles y que la seguridad del reportero era su máxima prioridad. El secretario jefe del Gabinete japonés, Minoru Kihara, dijo el miércoles que Tokio había solicitado información a las autoridades rusas y pedido un trato justo y consideraciones humanitarias para su ciudadano. Kihara evitó condenar a Moscú y se limitó a decir que Tokio tomaría las medidas apropiadas. En un reportaje de la televisión estatal rusa, tres hombres enmascarados y vestidos con uniformes negros esposaban a un hombre tendido en el suelo, mientras una voz fuera de cámara decía que era sospechoso de espionaje. El video mostraba al hombre subiendo a un avión acompañado por dos agentes del FSB y, posteriormente, dentro de una jaula en un tribunal de Moscú, que ordenó su detención durante casi dos meses. Es la detención de un periodista extranjero de mayor repercusión desde el arresto en 2023 del reportero de The Wall Street Journal Evan Gershkovich. Gershkovich, quien sostiene que su arresto fue una operación trampa cuidadosamente planificada por el FSB, fue declarado culpable de espionaje por un tribunal ruso, condenado a 16 años de prisión y posteriormente liberado en un intercambio de prisioneros entre Rusia y Occidente en agosto de 2024. El caso se suma a las prolongadas tensiones entre Rusia y Japón, que aún no han firmado un tratado formal de paz tras la Segunda Guerra Mundial debido a una disputa territorial por las islas Kuriles, conocidas en Japón como los Territorios del Norte.

item.title: Suiza, Noruega y Vietnam firmarán un acuerdo de libre comercio el domingo, según funcionarios
item.description: La Asociación Europea de Libre Comercio (AELC) y Vietnam tienen previsto firmar un acuerdo de libre comercio este domingo, según informaron esta semana fuentes oficiales, tras la reanudación el año pasado de unas negociaciones que llevaban mucho tiempo estancadas, en un contexto de tensiones globales por los aranceles estadounidenses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Asociación Europea de Libre Comercio (AELC) y Vietnam tienen previsto firmar un acuerdo de libre comercio este domingo, según informaron esta semana fuentes oficiales, tras la reanudación el año pasado de unas negociaciones que llevaban mucho tiempo estancadas, en un contexto de tensiones globales por los aranceles estadounidenses. Vietnam y el bloque de la AELC, que incluye a Suiza, Noruega, Islandia y Liechtenstein, concluyeron las negociaciones en julio tras años de conversaciones que se iniciaron en 2012. En septiembre, Vietnam anunció que había detenido a tres activistas por sospecha de terrorismo —entre ellos un ciudadano noruego—, lo que no afectó a la firma prevista inicialmente. Organizaciones de derechos humanos afirmaron que estas personas habían sido secuestradas en Camboya. El acuerdo se firmará en Hanói el domingo en presencia del ministro de Economía suizo, Guy Parmelin, según informó el miércoles un portavoz de su ministerio. Parmelin, que también ostenta la presidencia rotatoria de Suiza, se encuentra actualmente de visita en Asia. Dos responsables de Hanói confirmaron que la firma tendría lugar el domingo. En julio, la AELC señaló que el acuerdo abarcaría las normas de origen, la inversión, los derechos de propiedad intelectual y la competencia, medidas comerciales correctivas y la contratación pública. Responsables de Hanói habían indicado anteriormente que el acuerdo se firmaría en octubre, y que la fecha exacta dependería de las agendas de los líderes. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Vietnam no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Noruega no respondió a una pregunta sobre el impacto que la detención del ciudadano noruego Nguyen Duc Thuan podría tener en el acuerdo. Sin embargo, un portavoz dijo que el ministerio había solicitado a Vietnam que concediera acceso consular. A finales de septiembre, las autoridades vietnamitas afirmaron que Thuan había sido detenido por cargos de terrorismo junto con el ciudadano australiano Ho Pham Hiep Huy y el ciudadano vietnamita Thai Cong Truong Son. El Ministerio de Seguridad Pública dijo que los tres hombres habían sido detenidos el 18 de septiembre mientras intentaban cruzar ilegalmente de Camboya a Vietnam. Afirmó que los hombres son miembros de Viet Tan, un grupo prodemocrático con sede en Estados Unidos que el Gobierno comunista de Vietnam ha calificado de organización terrorista. Viet Tan dijo que los hombres habían sido secuestrados en Camboya. El Ministerio del Interior de Camboya declaró que las autoridades camboyanas no detuvieron a los activistas y que no tenían constancia de que hubieran salido del país. El miércoles, la organización no gubernamental con sede en EEUU Human Rights Watch pidió la liberación inmediata de los tres activistas "que desaparecieron en Camboya". Este mes, decenas de organizaciones internacionales de derechos humanos condenaron "el secuestro" en Camboya de los tres activistas y su detención en Vietnam.

item.title: UK media regulator says concerns persist over X's handling of illegal content
item.description: Britain's media regulator Ofcom said on Wednesday it remained concerned about Elon Musk-owned X's handling of illegal hate and terror content and was assessing whether the platform breached online safety laws, despite improvements in response times.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's media regulator Ofcom said on Wednesday it remained concerned about Elon Musk-owned X's handling of illegal hate and terror content and was assessing whether the platform breached online safety laws, despite improvements in response times. X's first quarterly report to Ofcom showed it had met commitments to review suspected illegal hate and terror content within agreed timeframes, with response times improving compared with evidence examined earlier this year. However, the regulator said it had "ongoing concerns" about the effectiveness of X's efforts to remove illegal hate and terror content and had received mixed reports over the company's engagement with third-party experts. The regulator also said that SpaceXAI, formerly xAI, had introduced further restrictions to its standalone Grok AI chatbot service, including measures preventing UK-based users from viewing, generating or sharing pornographic content and barring companion chatbots such as "Ani" from engaging in sexually explicit conversations. Ofcom opened its investigation in January after reports that Grok was being used to create and share sexualised images that could amount to illegal content. Reuters had found Grok was [USN:L6N3YY158 TEXT:"still generating sexualised images"] of people when prompted, even where users explicitly said the subjects had not consented. The regulator said it would now determine whether X had complied with its legal duties to protect people in Britain from illegal content. X did not immediately respond to a request for comment. .

item.title: Inflação ao produtor da China sobe com aumento das commodities; IPC fica abaixo das previsões
item.description: Os preços ao produtor da China registraram em setembro o maior ritmo de alta em mais de quatro anos, enquanto a inflação ao consumidor apresentou um leve aumento, já que o aumento dos preços do petróleo e das commodities elevou os custos na saída da fábrica, mesmo com a fraca demanda interna mantendo contidas as pressões gerais sobre os preços.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os preços ao produtor da China registraram em setembro o maior ritmo de alta em mais de quatro anos, enquanto a inflação ao consumidor apresentou um leve aumento, já que o aumento dos preços do petróleo e das commodities elevou os custos na saída da fábrica, mesmo com a fraca demanda interna mantendo contidas as pressões gerais sobre os preços. Os dados sugerem que os preços estão subindo para os fabricantes, mas a fraca demanda do consumidor continua a conter a inflação, reforçando as preocupações de que a China ainda enfrente uma recuperação desigual, impulsionada mais pelas exportações do que pelos gastos. Os gastos das famílias permanecem moderados e a confiança do setor privado continua frágil, apesar de uma série de medidas de estímulo, o que ressalta a fraqueza persistente da demanda interna e os desequilíbrios econômicos mais amplos. O índice de preços ao produtor subiu 5% em relação ao ano anterior, segundo dados divulgados na quarta-feira pelo Departamento Nacional de Estatísticas, acima dos 3,8% registrados em agosto e superando o aumento estimado de 4,5% em uma pesquisa da Reuters. Isso marca o ritmo mais rápido da inflação na porta da fábrica desde junho de 2022. “Grande parte da pressão de alta ainda veio das interrupções no abastecimento de commodities causadas pelo conflito no Oriente Médio, com os preços subindo de forma particularmente acentuada no processamento de combustíveis, produtos químicos e metais não ferrosos”, disse Nguyen Hoang Nam, economista especializado na China da Capital Economics, que espera que os preços recuem no próximo ano. Os preços mais altos do petróleo e das commodities, impulsionados por interrupções no transporte, condições climáticas adversas e tensões geopolíticas, aumentaram as pressões de custo para os fabricantes, embora a demanda fraca tenha limitado o repasse desses custos aos consumidores. O índice de preços ao consumidor (IPC) subiu 0,9% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior, em comparação com um aumento de 0,8% em agosto, ficando abaixo da previsão dos economistas de um aumento de 1%. Os preços da gasolina dispararam 16,6% em relação ao ano anterior e contribuíram com cerca de 0,47 pontos percentuais para o crescimento do IPC geral, informou a agência de estatísticas. As pressões subjacentes sobre os preços ao consumidor, no entanto, permaneceram moderadas, sugerindo que as famílias ainda estão cautelosas em relação aos gastos. A inflação básica, que exclui os preços voláteis de alimentos e energia, subiu 1% em relação ao ano anterior, mantendo-se inalterada em relação a agosto. Zhou Hao, economista-chefe da Guotai Junan International, afirmou que uma questão fundamental é se o impulso industrial mais forte poderá, gradualmente, se refletir no emprego, no crescimento da renda e na confiança do consumidor. “Se esse mecanismo de transmissão melhorar, a divergência atual entre os preços ao produtor e ao consumidor poderá diminuir do lado da demanda, criando uma recuperação mais equilibrada e duradoura em 2027.” Pequim intensificou o apoio à economia, aprovando 550 bilhões de iuanes (US$82,15 bilhões) adicionais em cotas não utilizadas de títulos de dívida pública local para infraestrutura e outros gastos, somando-se a medidas como subsídios para hipotecas. Em relação ao mês anterior, o IPC subiu 0,2%, contra expectativas de um aumento de 0,3% e um aumento de 0,4% em agosto. (Reportagem de Qiaoyi Li e Liz Lee)

item.title: Liberia offers 29 offshore blocks in 2026 oil and gas licensing round
item.description: Liberia on Wednesday launched its 2026 oil and gas auction round, offering direct negotiations on 29 offshore blocks to try to attract international oil companies and boost exploration, its regulatory authority said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Liberia on Wednesday launched its 2026 oil and gas auction round, offering direct negotiations on 29 offshore blocks to try to attract international oil companies and boost exploration, its regulatory authority said. The West African country, which currently does not produce any oil, showcased its Liberia and Harper Basins at an energy conference in Cape Town During the last auction round in 2024, eight production sharing contracts were signed, with French oil major [USN:L2N3V406L TEXT:"TotalEnergies"] (TTEF.PA) awarded four blocks and Nigeria's Oranto Petroleum another four blocks In promotional material, the Liberia Petroleum Regulatory Authority said its Harper Basin was attracting attention due to similar geological properties found in the petroleum system of neighbouring Ivory Coast where Eni (ENI.MI) discovered its large [USN:L1N4220A9 TEXT:"Baleine"] and Calao fields

item.title: Large dogs age more quickly than small dogs at a molecular level
item.description: Few animals show the link between size and lifespan as clearly as dogs. Within this one species, large breeds such as Great Danes typically die younger than small ones such as Chihuahuas. A new study indicates the reason may lie in how DNA changes with age in dogs.
item.dc:creator: Marta Serafinko
item.content:encoded: Few animals show the link between size and lifespan as clearly as [USN:L1N40B0RM TEXT:"dogs"]. Within this one species, large breeds such as Great Danes typically die younger than small ones such as Chihuahuas. A new study indicates the reason may lie in how DNA changes with age in dogs. Across mammals, bigger species like [USN:L1N3I60AL TEXT:"elephants"] usually live longer lives than smaller ones like [USN:L6N43F0U9 TEXT:"mice"], but within a species that pattern can reverse. Earlier comparisons across species linked certain biological mechanisms to exceptional longevity, but those are less suited to explaining differences among individuals within a species. "We all know that big dogs usually don't live as long as small dogs, but we have not known whether their cells actually age faster, or whether they simply hit certain diseases earlier," said Noah Snyder-Mackler, a professor at Arizona State University's School of Life Sciences and Center for Evolution and Medicine and one of the authors of the study published in the journal Science . To find out, the researchers measured DNA methylation, chemical tags that help control which genes are switched on and off. Using age-related patterns in these tags, they built an epigenetic clock that estimated a dog's age with a median error of less than one year. Analyzing 1,640 blood methylation profiles from 894 pet canines of various breeds, they found that larger dogs and male dogs showed signs of accelerated molecular aging, while dogs whose biological age appeared older than expected based on the profiles faced a higher risk of early death. "We found that large dogs show a faster-moving DNA methylation aging signature in blood, and that this acceleration is especially strong in parts of the genome that normally help keep 'jumping genes' quiet," Snyder-Mackler said. Jumping genes, also called transposable elements, can copy themselves and insert into new spots in the genome. LINE1s are a type of jumping gene that is normally kept silent by DNA methylation, but their activation has been linked to genome instability, cancer and other age-related disease. In large dogs, Snyder-Mackler said, "methylation at those regions appears to erode more quickly with age, as if the genome is losing some of the tape or clamps that keep these mobile elements suppressed." This suggests that the shorter lives of large dogs reflect a faster molecular aging trajectory. "If large dogs simply died earlier after following the same molecular trajectory, we would look for late-life triggers of disease or mortality. But if parts of the aging program move faster throughout adulthood, as our data suggest for the blood methylome, then there may be processes we can measure, follow over time, and potentially modify before disease appears," Snyder-Mackler said. DIFFERENCES BY SEX The researchers also found differences between male and female dogs, largely on the X chromosome — the sex chromosome that females carry in two copies and males in one. There, LINE1 elements showed higher methylation in males. Chromosomes are thread-like structures that carry genetic information inside cell nuclei. "In our genome-wide analyses, the sex signal looked distinct from the body-size signal, so I would treat that as a separate biology that needs follow-up rather than the same mechanism in disguise," Snyder-Mackler said. The trade-off between large size and longevity may be a consequence of selective breeding rather than natural evolution. Humans bred dogs to grow quickly and reach large adult sizes for tasks such as guarding, hunting and herding. "If selection strongly favors rapid growth or large adult size before old age, late-life costs can come along for the ride," Snyder-Mackler added. Previous explanations for why large dogs tend to have shorter lives focused on growth biology. Researchers have also suggested that larger dogs may undergo more cell growth, develop more quickly or face a higher risk of cancer. "Our study does not replace those ideas; it gives us a molecular layer downstream of body size," Snyder-Mackler said. The findings raise the possibility that slowing molecular aging could help extend healthy lifespan in larger dogs. Snyder-Mackler said, however, that lifespan is not governed by a single biological clock. Large dogs would still face breed-specific risks, meaning that slowing molecular aging would not turn a Great Dane into a Chihuahua, in terms of lifespan, but could make one component of its aging trajectory less compressed.

item.title: As Ebola spreads in eastern Congo, mothers and children shun vital care
item.description: The fear of Ebola is keeping women and children from seeking healthcare in eastern Congo, health workers and aid agencies say, contributing to soaring maternal deaths and falling childhood immunization rates that could strain the healthcare system for years to come.
item.dc:creator: Gradel Muyisa Mumbere, Clement Bonnerot
item.content:encoded: The fear of Ebola is keeping women and children from seeking healthcare in eastern Congo, health workers and aid agencies say, contributing to soaring maternal deaths and falling childhood immunization rates that could strain the healthcare system for years to come. Health workers say that misplaced anxiety about contact with Ebola is the primary reason women are forgoing crucial prenatal care and opting to give birth at home, and dying more often in the event of complications. There is still limited data available but figures for Ituri province are raising alarm. UN figures show that maternal deaths in Ituri province soared nearly 70% between May and July compared with a year earlier, a troubling indicator of the impact of the Ebola outbreak — currently Congo's worst on record — on the primary healthcare system. Steep international aid cuts have also led to shortages of some life-saving medications. In eastern Butembo city, nurses at the Masiki healthcare center told Reuters that births have fallen sharply at their maternity ward since the Ebola outbreak was declared in May. Just one mother was resting with her newborn during a recent visit, among rows of empty beds. "They think the medicines we give them contain the Ebola virus," head nurse Liliane Adronga told Reuters — highlighting just one of many unfounded suspicions circulating about the virus and healthcare. Adronga described how women often avoided seeking care until it was too late, recalling a recent case where a woman was believed to have lost her baby while suffering from untreated malaria. The UNFPA has reported a more than 30% drop in hospital deliveries and 50% drop in treatment for obstetric complications for the May to July period since the outbreak began. CHILDREN MISSING ROUTINE VACCINES The Ebola outbreak has spread across seven provinces, infecting more than 8,000 people and killing over 4,000. Officials say it is far from being contained, although infections have slowed in parts of the country. Routine data collection is a growing challenge but aid agencies say data for the first three months of the outbreak shows a sharp fall in routine childhood vaccinations and paediatric visits. UNICEF warned in August that routine vaccinations fell by more than half across Ebola hot spots in Ituri between April and June. In Mongbwalu, first-dose measles vaccinations declined by 69%. "We should be concerned not only about the direct impact of Ebola, but also its indirect effects on health, nutrition, child protection and insecurity," said Raoul Kamadjeu, a public health emergencies expert at UNICEF. "The longer an epidemic persists, the greater the risks." Congo has long struggled with recurring measles outbreaks for example, with tens of thousands of cases recorded every year, and 126,000 cases so far in 2026, according to data by Congo's health ministry. UNICEF says that across the province, health facilities administered 23,000 fewer routine vaccine doses in May and June than in April. MISINFORMATION, SUPERSTITION ADDING TO CONCERNS For some parents, concerns about Ebola overshadowed the benefits of vaccination. "We didn't want to bring our children to health facilities for fear of being referred to an Ebola treatment center. Because once you end up there, you can die," said Masika Furaha, a mother of three in Butembo. She did in the end have her youngest child vaccinated after seeing that children who received the shots remained healthy. Dr. Mupenzi Mumbere, a paediatrician in Butembo, said misinformation is contributing to the fears among parents with sometimes tragic consequences. He described an episode in which a mother burst into tears when he referred her son to the main hospital for an X-ray because she believed staff would take him and kill him with Ebola. Many parents first try self-medication or seek help from traditional healers before eventually turning to hospitals, he said, often with devastating consequences. "That's when I realised how great the misunderstanding was," said Mumbere. "In the worst cases, children arrive in such poor condition that there is little left to do but watch them die."

item.title: Space startups secure record $20.8 billion funding as infrastructure bets surge, report shows
item.description: Space startups attracted a record $20.8 billion in funding in the third quarter, as investors poured money into launch providers, manufacturing and other infrastructure ventures, according to a report by global investment firm Seraphim.
item.dc:creator: Prathik Jayaprakash
item.content:encoded: Space startups attracted a record $20.8 billion in funding in the third quarter, as investors poured money into launch providers, manufacturing and other infrastructure ventures, according to a report by global investment firm Seraphim. The figure was nearly triple the $7.4 billion invested in the second quarter and more than double the prior peak. Excluding [USN:L6N43A0QG TEXT:"Blue Origin's $10 billion financing"], investment was still at an all-time high of $10.8 billion, underscoring growing demand across the sector. The report, released on Wednesday, also showed a record 216 deals were completed during the quarter, up from 140 in the second quarter. While SpaceX remains a dominant force in the industry, recent fundraising has been supported by a growing pipeline of commercial orders and government-backed programs, according to Seraphim. "Capital is following evidence of commercial and institutional demand, not just residual IPO enthusiasm," said Lucas Bishop, vice president at Seraphim Space. Infrastructure-related businesses accounted for the bulk of the funding activity. Companies involved in launch and broader space access attracted $16.4 billion across 120 deals, while satellite communications, Earth observation and other space-service companies raised $4 billion. Defense and sovereign demand are increasingly supporting investment in launch, manufacturing and orbital infrastructure as governments prioritize domestic space capabilities, Bishop said. The quarter's major fundraising rounds included $1.37 billion for Hadrian, $1 billion for Stoke Space and [USN:L6N43W159 TEXT:"$500 million"] for K2 Space. However, the surge in private investment was in contrast with weaker performance among listed space companies. Bishop said many publicly traded space firms remain loss-making, while SpaceX's scale and visibility may have drawn investor attention away from smaller listed peers. North America accounted for about 70% of global funding year-to-date, while China recorded a quarterly high of $3.3 billion across 49 deals. Seraphim said funding was likely to moderate from the third-quarter's exceptional level, but remain above historical norms as more companies enter growth and scale-up phases.

item.title: 中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株1年超ぶり安値、ＡＩ関連株に売り
item.description: [上海 １４日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は下落し１年超ぶりの安値で引けた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連サプライチェーン銘柄...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
中国・香港株式市場・大引け＝中国株1年超ぶり安値、ＡＩ関連株に売り 18:00 配信

[上海 １４日 ロイター] - 中国株式市場は下落し１年超ぶりの安値で引けた。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連サプライチェーン銘柄が売られた。

ＣＳＩ３００指数は終盤に２０２５年８月以来の安値を付け、１．４％安で終了。上海総合指数は０．９％安。

香港のハンセン指数は０．１％安。大手テック株は０．９％上昇したが、依然２年ぶりの安値付近にとどまっている。

中国の９月の生産者物価指数（ＰＰＩ）は４年超ぶりの高い伸びとなった一方、消費者物価は市場予想を下回る伸びにとどまった。原油やコモディティー（商品）価格の高騰が、上流部門の価格を押し上げた一方、国内需要の弱さが幅広い物価圧力を抑制した。

原油高を背景にＣＳＩエネルギー指数は約２％上昇した。

生活必需品株は０．３％高。

ＡＩサプライチェーン関連銘柄は後場に一段安。５Ｇ通信指数は３．８％下落。上海証券取引所の新興ハイテク企業向け株式市場｢科創板」の科創板５０指数は３．３％安となった。

中国の株価指数は、政府の大規模景気刺激策を受けて急伸した２年前の水準に近づいている。ＨＳＢＣのアナリストは、上海総合、ＣＳＩ３００、深セン総合各指数の２０２６年末目標を９─１５％引き下げ、それぞれ４１００、４８００、１万４５００とした。現在の水準から８─１５％の上昇余地があることを意味する。

ＨＳＢＣは、バリュー株は７月以降グロース株をアウトパフォームしているが、グロース株のバリュエーションの低さや利益見通しの上方修正の勢いの強さを理由に、この傾向は一時的なものにとどまる可能性があると指摘した。

item.title: Japan's Takaichi to sack farm minister Yana, Mainichi newspaper reports
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has decided to replace farm minister Kazuo Yana, who had come under fire for his remarks about slashing road funding for municipalities that did not support him, the Mainichi newspaper reported on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Satoshi Sugiyama
item.content:encoded: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has decided to replace farm minister Kazuo Yana, who had come under fire for his remarks about slashing road funding for municipalities that did not support him, the Mainichi newspaper reported on Wednesday. His resignation would mark the first for the administration of Takaichi, whose popularity has remained at relatively high levels since she took her post a year ago. Takaichi appointed Yana in a cabinet reshuffle last month to lead the ministry overseeing agriculture, forestry and fisheries, but had openly chided him in parliament for the remarks over the road funding, which local media first reported earlier this month. The resignation comes during an extraordinary parliamentary session in which Takaichi faces a high-stakes challenge to win approval for key policy goals including a temporary sales tax cut on food and beverages. Opposition parties in parliament's upper house, where the ruling coalition lacks a majority, were preparing a no-confidence motion against Yana, while some threatened to block debate on the sales tax legislation until he stepped down, according to local media reports. Yana confirmed the authenticity of an audio clip, obtained by several local media, in which he said one reason for the budget cuts in two municipalities in his constituency was their support of a rival candidate in a general election held in February. He has since denied having the power to sway such budget decisions. His comment quickly drew wide criticism as an abuse of power. An opinion poll by public broadcaster NHK this week showed 78% of respondents saying Yana's explanation was unacceptable. Support for Takaichi's cabinet fell 2 percentage points from last month's poll but remained elevated at 51%, according to the same survey. Grilled in parliament, Yana has also admitted that his campaign provided free transportation for supporters to attend his election rally, a move that some lawmakers criticised as a potential violation of election law.

item.title: India importers press on with rupee hedges despite RBI's higher-cost deterrent
item.description: Indian importers continue to lock in future dollar purchase rates to protect against the rupee weakening, despite the banks charging more per month for such trades following the central bank's step to make them more expensive.
item.dc:creator: Nimesh Vora
item.content:encoded: Indian importers continue to lock in future dollar purchase rates to protect against the rupee weakening, despite the banks charging more per month for such trades following the central bank's step to make them more expensive. The Reserve Bank of India now requires banks to set aside cash equivalent to 20% of the notional value of the forward dollar contracts they sell. With banks passing the cost of complying on to clients, importers have to pay 11 to 14 paisa per month more to lock in future dollar purchases. However, forward dollar contracts remained attractive for importers. The rupee's recovery, after the Reserve Bank of India set out a series of measures to support the currency, helped offset these charges, bankers told Reuters. They requested anonymity since they were not authorised to speak to the media. The currency has strengthened to a high of 94.72 rupees per dollar on Wednesday from levels near 96.70 last week. SHORTER TENOR HEDGES The charges vary, depending on the cost of funds, a treasury official at a private-sector lender said, with the cost rising with the length of the contract — meaning, additional costs for near-term contracts are lower than for longer-term ones. As a result, hedging activity is now concentrated in shorter-term forward contracts of up to three months, bankers said. "For importers this is a good opportunity to buy dollars and hedge. The approach should be to hedge as short-term as possible, and to use low-cost options," said Samir Lodha, managing director at Mumbai-based QuantArt Market Solutions. The benefit of option structures can negate part of the extra cost of hedging arising from RBI's new measures, he added. The continued appetite for forward dollar contracts among importers complicates the RBI's efforts to curb dollar demand and support the rupee. The central bank's interventions spur rupee rallies, which offer importers an opportunity to lock in more favourable exchange rates and draw them back into the forward market, which in turn could renew the dollar demand that the RBI is seeking to curb.

item.title: H&M says website availability affected by maintenance, not external influence
item.description: H&M is performing a routine maintenance update on its digital platforms, which is taking longer than expected, affecting the availability of its retail websites, the Swedish company said in a statement to Reuters on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: H&M (HMb.ST) is performing a routine maintenance update on its digital platforms, which is taking longer than expected, affecting the availability of its retail websites, the Swedish company said in a statement to Reuters on Wednesday. The disruption "is not related to any external events or external influence", the company added.

item.title: GSK to cut up to 1,217 jobs in Belgium
item.description: GSK is planning to cut up to 1,217 jobs from its sites in Belgium, the British biopharmaceutical company said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: GSK (GSK.L) is planning to cut up to 1,217 jobs from its sites in Belgium, the British biopharmaceutical company said on Wednesday. The company announced the plan to unions earlier on Wednesday, Belgian newspaper L'Echo reported Unions did not immediately respond to requests for comment GSK remains the largest employer in the biopharmaceutical sector in Belgium, the company said "GSK Belgium informed its extraordinary works council today that it intends to reorganise certain operations. This plan could affect up to 1,217 employees across its various Belgian sites," the company said in a statement, adding that factory workers would not be affected

item.title: ＬＳＥＧ、エヌビディアと提携 過去の市場データ分析を高速化
item.description: [１４日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧ（ロンドン証券取引所グループ）は１４日、米半導体大手エヌビディアと提携したと発表し...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＬＳＥＧ、エヌビディアと提携　過去の市場データ分析を高速化 17:42 配信

ロンドンのLSEG本社で9月撮影。 REUTERS/Toby Melville

[１４日 ロイター] - ＬＳＥＧ（ロンドン証券取引所グループ）は１４日、米半導体大手エヌビディアと提携したと発表した。エヌビディアの技術を活用し、金融機関が大量の過去の市場データをより高速かつ大規模に処理・分析できるよう支援する。

ＬＳＥＧによると、エヌビディアの専用プロセッサーを使えば、元のデータを複製せずにそのまま処理し、全ての取引と気配値を数秒で調べて分析結果を得られる可能性が示された。株式取引の２４時間化が進む中、調査をより速く、リアルタイムに近い形で行えるようになるという。

ＬＳＥＧのデータ・分析部門の共同責任者ロン・レファーツ氏は「今回の提携により、顧客は信頼性が高く、適切に管理されたＬＳＥＧの『ティック・ヒストリー』から、より多様な方法で情報を得られるようになる。顧客は詳細な過去のデータを高速で処理したいと考えている」と述べた。

同社によると、ティック・ヒストリーには、５８０の取引所や取引施設、データ提供者から集めた３０年分のデータが収められている。対象は１億の金融商品で、データ量は約１１０兆行に上る。

item.title: ウクライナ首都などに攻撃、エネ施設標的 「米軽視」とゼレンスキー氏
item.description:
Dan Peleschuk
[１４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Dan Peleschuk

[１４日 ロイター] - ロシア軍は１３日夜から１４日未明にかけて首都キーウなどを攻撃した。キーウでは３人が死亡し、大規模な停電が発生した。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、トランプ米大統領の和平努力に対する「あからさまな軽視」だと非難した。

ゼレンスキー氏によると、主にキーウと第２の都市ハルキウがミサイルとドローン（無人機）による攻撃を受けた。エネルギー施設３０カ所が被害を受けた。少なくとも６０万人が停電の影響を受けているという。

同氏は「攻撃は完全に意図的であり、その規模を見せつけるものだった。ロシアはこれまで米国に対し、これほどあからさまな軽視を示したことはない」とＸに投稿。「ロシアは米大統領の発言に重みがないと見なしている」と指摘した。

コレツキー首相は、国内の国営鉄道施設も標的となったと述べた。

ロシア国防省は１４日、キーウとその周辺にある発電所４カ所、ハリコフの２カ所などを攻撃したと発表した。

ウクライナ空軍によると、ミサイル３９発中、迎撃できたのはわずか４発にとどまった。

item.title: EU delays methane rules on oil and gas imports for a year
item.description: The European Commission proposed a one-year delay to the EU's methane emissions rules for oil and gas imports on Wednesday, after pressure from governments including France and the United States.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Commission proposed a one-year delay to the EU's methane emissions rules for oil and gas imports on Wednesday, after pressure from governments including France and the United States. The rules, due to take effect on January 1, 2027, would have required foreign oil and gas suppliers to the EU to monitor and report methane, a potent greenhouse gas. Under the proposed changes, importers of oil and gas would have until 31 May 2029 to prove that their oil, gas and coal imports during 2028 complied with methane monitoring and reporting rules equivalent to those of the EU - meaning that their foreign suppliers of these fuels would need to provide the information. "This one-year postponement of the import-related provisions is designed to help avoid additional pressures on the security of supply of imported fossil fuels in the current geopolitical context," the Commission said in a statement. Methane is the second-largest contributor to climate change, after carbon dioxide. The world-first EU law was designed to tackle those emissions, which leach into the atmosphere from leaky oil and gas infrastructure around the world. But the law has faced growing political pressure after the Iran war disrupted global energy supplies and heightened concerns about fuel availability this winter. The United States, Europe's biggest liquefied natural gas supplier, warned the EU in June that the methane law could disrupt fuel deliveries, a stance backed by companies including oil major ExxonMobil (XOM.N) . The Commission moved ahead with the delay after French President Emmanuel Macron last month wrote to European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen to request it, and warn the rules could create legal risks for Europe's fuel importers. Those seeking a delay say that foreign oil and gas companies are not ready to comply with the EU rules and would avoid sending LNG cargoes to Europe because of the risk of fines or legal issues. EU countries and the European Parliament must negotiate and approve the delay. Some EU lawmakers and countries, including Czechia and Italy, have demanded a longer three-year delay and may attempt to win this in the final negotiations.

item.title: China’s Huajin Aramco Project Receives First Arabian Crude Shipment
item.description: Chinese-Saudi joint venture Huajin Aramco Petrochemical Co has received its first shipment of Arabian crude at its refinery and petrochemical complex in northeastern China, bringing the delayed project closer to starting operations, according to a company statement dated Oct. 9. The complex in Panjin, Liaoning …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Chinese-Saudi joint venture Huajin Aramco Petrochemical Co has received its first shipment of Arabian crude at its refinery and petrochemical complex in northeastern China, bringing the delayed project closer to starting operations, according to a company statement dated Oct. 9.

The complex in Panjin, Liaoning province, is in the pre-production preparation phase, the company said.

It is expected to include a refinery capable of processing 300,000 barrels per day, alongside chemical facilities with annual production capacity of 1.65 million metric tons of ethylene and 2 million tons of paraxylene.

Reuters previously reported that the complex had pushed back its planned startup to September or early October from May or June. The latest statement did not specify when operations would begin.

China’s state-owned Zhenhua Oil had booked 2 million barrels of Saudi crude for loading in August to supply the complex, Reuters previously reported.

Jia Fei, chairman of Panjin Xincheng, said the project would support the expansion of higher-value products and fine chemicals while strengthening the integration of refining and chemical production.

It would also advance Panjin’s ambition to become a nationally recognised centre for the petrochemical and fine chemicals industries, Jia said.
item.wire:summarySource: The China-Global South Project source metadata
item.wire:bodySource: The China-Global South Project public article data

item.title: Switzerland, Norway, Vietnam to sign free trade deal on Sunday, officials say
item.description: The European Free Trade Association (EFTA) and Vietnam are set to sign a free trade deal on Sunday, officials said this week, after long-stalled talks were relaunched last year amid global tensions over US tariffs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Free Trade Association (EFTA) and Vietnam are set to sign a free trade deal on Sunday, officials said this week, after long-stalled talks were relaunched last year amid global tensions over US tariffs. Vietnam and the EFTA bloc, which includes Switzerland, Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein, [USN:L8N4330KG TEXT:"concluded negotiations"] in July after years of talks which were first launched in 2012. In September, Vietnam said it detained three activists on suspicion of terrorism - including a Norwegian national - which did not affect the previously planned signing. Human rights groups said the people had been abducted in Cambodia. The deal will be signed in Hanoi on Sunday in the presence of Swiss Economy Minister Guy Parmelin, a spokesperson for his ministry said on Wednesday. Parmelin, who also holds Switzerland's rotating presidency, is currently on a visit to Asia. Two officials in Hanoi confirmed that the signing would occur on Sunday. In July, the EFTA said the accord would cover rules of origin, investment, intellectual property rights and competition, trade remedies and government procurement. Officials in Hanoi had earlier said the deal would have been signed in October, with the precise date determined by the leaders' agendas. Vietnam's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a request for comment. Norway's foreign ministry did not answer a question about the impact that the detention of Norwegian citizen Nguyen Duc Thuan might have on the deal. A spokesperson said, however, that the ministry had asked Vietnam to grant consular access. In late September, Vietnamese authorities said Thuan [USN:L6N45L059 TEXT:"was detained"] on terrorism charges together with Australian citizen Ho Pham Hiep Huy and Vietnamese national Thai Cong Truong Son. The ministry of public security said the three men had been arrested on September 18 while trying to illegally cross from Cambodia into Vietnam. It said the men are members of Viet Tan, a US-based pro-democracy group that Vietnam's Communist government has designated as a terrorist organisation. Viet Tan said the men had been abducted in Cambodia. Cambodia's Ministry of Interior said Cambodian authorities did not arrest the activists and had no records of them departing from the country. On Wednesday, the US-based, non-governmental group Human Rights Watch called for the immediate release of the three activists "who went missing in Cambodia." Earlier in October, dozens of international human rights organisations condemned "the abduction" in Cambodia of the three activists and their detention in Vietnam.

item.title: ウクライナ、ロシア最大のデータセンター攻撃 業務に影響なし
item.description: ［モスクワ １４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［モスクワ　１４日　ロイター］ - ロシア最大手の銀行ズベルバンクが所有する同国最大のデータセンターが、ウクライナの無人機の攻撃を受けた。同社幹部が１４日明らかにした。業務に影響は出ていないという。

この１週間に、ハイテク大手ヤンデックスが所有するデータセンターが３回にわたり攻撃を受けた。ウクライナ側は、自国のデータ施設に対するロシアの攻撃に対抗していると主張している。

ズベルバンクの幹部は記者団に対し、「データ処理センターが攻撃を受けたことは事実だ。ただ、ズベルバンクの全てのシステムとサービスは通常通り稼働しており、支障は出ていない」と述べた。

攻撃を受けたデータセンターは、サラトフ州のボルガ川沿いの都市バラコボにある。ロシア国営ＲＩＡノーボスチ通信は２０２４年に、同センターに国内最大のスーパーコンピューターが設置され、２７年に稼働予定と報じた。

item.title: Sanofi avoids fine as EU accepts offer to stop disparaging rival vaccine
item.description: French pharmaceutical company Sanofi has staved off a potential hefty fine after European Union antitrust regulators on Wednesday said they had accepted its offer to stop disparaging a rival flu vaccine.
item.dc:creator: Yun Chee Foo
item.content:encoded: French pharmaceutical company Sanofi (SASY.PA) has staved off a potential hefty fine after European Union antitrust regulators on Wednesday said they had accepted its offer to stop disparaging a rival flu vaccine. The European Commission [USN:L8N42Y0LC TEXT:"opened an investigation"] in June into whether Sanofi disparaged a vaccine called "Fluad" made by CSL Seqirus (CSL.AX) , primarily in France and Germany, which competes with its "Efluelda" flu vaccine. In its initial response, the French drugmaker said it was confident it complied with all applicable laws, but subsequently [USN:L8N43A0UZ TEXT:"proposed a series of measures"] to address the EU competition enforcer's concerns to avert potential charges and a fine of as much as 10% of its global annual turnover. "To their credit, Sanofi has engaged helpfully with the Commission since the beginning of our investigation. And it is this engagement that has allowed us to reach a very fast and effective outcome," EU antitrust chief Teresa Ribera told a press conference, announcing the approval of Sanofi's proposed actions. The Commission said Sanofi will not use promotional materials aimed at healthcare professionals in Germany and France to criticise national vaccination recommendations nor highlight negatively the rival vaccine or that its own product is safer. This pledge is valid until 2030. CSL Seqirus welcomed the EU decision. "The Commission's decision reinforces the importance of accurate, evidence-based vaccine communications that reflect independent scientific assessments and national vaccine recommendations," the company said in an emailed statement. Under the agreement with the EU regulators, Sanofi will also publish in the next two years a statement on its German and French websites acknowledging and clarifying that the applicable national vaccination recommendations treat Fluad and Efluelda as equivalent in protecting elderly people against the flu.

item.title: ＥＵ、重要鉱物巡りベトナムとの関係強化目指す 中国依存低減へ
item.description:
Francesco Guarascio
[ハノイ １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Francesco Guarascio

[ハノイ １４日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）は、中国への依存を減らすため、ベトナムからの重要鉱物の調達拡大を目指している。ロイターが確認したＥＵの内部文書で明らかになった。現在の供給が脅かされることへの懸念が背景にある。

ベトナムには、タングステン、レアアース、アンチモン、ビスマス、ボーキサイトなどの重要鉱物が豊富に埋蔵されている。ＥＵ向け輸出はこれまで、主にタングステンとアンチモンに限られてきた。いずれも弾薬や爆薬など、防衛分野で使われる。

ハノイのＥＵ代表部が作成した文書には「欧州が可能な限り迅速に再軍備とリスク低減を進める必要があることを踏まえると、特にレアアースとタングステンの埋蔵量が豊富なベトナムを、重要原材料の供給国候補として無視するわけにはいかない」と記されている。

２０２６年６月付の報告書と付属文書は、他国との調達競争がＥＵへの供給を妨げる恐れがあると警告。「特にタングステン、ビスマス、アンチモン、チタンの現在の調達経路を維持・拡大する」ため、ベトナムの鉱業・加工業への資金支援を提言した。

文書は、世界最大の重要鉱物生産国である「中国に代わる調達先を加える」ため、ベトナムとの関係強化が必要だと指摘した。

item.title: Des frappes russes font 3 morts à Kyiv, infrastructures énergétiques ciblées
item.description: Des frappes russes ont fait trois morts à Kyiv et ont endommagé nombre d'infrastructures énergétiques, plongeant des centaines de milliers de personnes dans le noir pendant la nuit de mardi à mercredi, ont déclaré les autorités.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Des frappes russes ont fait trois morts à Kyiv et ont endommagé nombre d'infrastructures énergétiques, plongeant des centaines de milliers de personnes dans le noir pendant la nuit de mardi à mercredi, ont déclaré les autorités. L'attaque, menée avec des missiles balistiques et des drones, a duré plusieurs heures et a également visé Kharkiv, la deuxième plus grande ville d'Ukraine, a précisé le président Volodimir Zelensky, suggérant que Moscou se moquait des efforts de paix du président américain Donald Trump avec ces nouvelles frappes. Ces dernières ont endommagé 30 installations énergétiques du pays et au moins 600.000 personnes se sont retrouvées sans électricité, a-t-il ajouté. Volodimir Zelensky a également estimé injuste le fait que Kyiv a une nouvelle fois été frappée sans que l'Ukraine n'ait été prévenue au préalable par ses partenaires occidentaux. Le président américain Donald Trump, qui a annoncé dimanche la conclusion d'un accord de [USN:L8N45X03P TEXT:"cessez-le-feu énergétique"] entre l'Ukraine et la Russie, a assuré mardi que Washington continuait de partager des renseignements avec Kyiv et que les efforts de son administration pour mettre fin à la guerre se poursuivaient. "Les faits montrent que les Russes ne se considèrent pas tenus de respecter ce qu'a déclaré le président des États-Unis", a encore dit Volodimir Zelensky par allusion à la soi-disant trêve énergétique entre les deux pays. "Cette frappe était tout à fait délibérée et son ampleur était une véritable démonstration de force : la Russie n'avait jamais auparavant fait preuve d’un tel mépris manifeste envers les États-Unis", a encore dit le président ukrainien. Le ministère russe de la Défense a dit de son côté que ses forces avaient frappé sept infrastructures énergétiques ukrainiennes, dont plusieurs à Kyiv, lors d'une attaque massive menée pendant la nuit. Moscou a également frappé un centre de données situé dans la capitale ukrainienne qui, selon le ministère, servait à recueillir des renseignements sur les forces armées russes. RESTRICTIONS DE STARLINK EN UKRAINE Selon Serhii Beskrestnov, conseiller auprès du ministère ukrainien de la Défense, SpaceX a imposé une restriction sur certains services de son réseau Starlink en Ukraine, suspendant le fonctionnement de sa version de niveau militaire à des vitesses supérieures à 160 km/h, ce qui perturbe les missions de combat. "Nos forces de défense n'ont reçu aucun avertissement concernant cette restriction, ce qui a entraîné la perturbation de plusieurs missions", a-t-il dit sur Telegram. Les terminaux internet par satellite de SpaceX, société dirigée par le milliardaire Elon Musk, proche de Donald Trump, sont indispensables pour guider les frappes de drones à longue portée menées par l'Ukraine, qui ont freiné l'effort de guerre russe. Starlink n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire. Le moins bon fonctionnement de ses services intervient à un moment où Washington fait pression sur l'Ukraine pour cesser ses frappes sur les raffineries russes. Pour tenter d'enrayer la machine de guerre russe, aux équipements plus modernes et aux troupes plus nombreuses, l'Ukraine a adopté la stratégie de frapper des [USN:L6N45P05R TEXT:"raffineries"], poussant Moscou à suspendre ses exportations de diesel et provoquant depuis plusieurs semaines la colère de Donald Trump. Sans mentionner l'impact de la guerre qu'il mène contre l'Iran, Donald Trump a accusé à plusieurs reprises l'Ukraine d'être responsable de la flambée des prix du diesel aux Etats-Unis, un motif de mécontentement majeur pour de nombreux Américains et donc un sujet d'inquiétude au sein de son camp républicain à l'approche des élections législatives de mi-mandat le 3 novembre. L'armée de l'air ukrainienne a précisé que les défenses aériennes du pays avaient abattu quatre des 39 missiles balistiques lancés par la Russie au cours de la nuit, un ratio qui illustre le manque criant de systèmes d'interception dont souffre l'Ukraine.

item.title: 米との貿易交渉「ほぼ完了」とベトナム副首相、米側は協議中と説明
item.description:
Khanh Vu Francesco Guarascio
[ハノイ １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Khanh Vu　Francesco Guarascio

[ハノイ １４日 ロイター] - ベトナムのファム・ザー・トゥック副首相は１４日、ハノイで開かれたビジネス会合で、米国との貿易協定交渉がほぼ完了したと述べた。一方、米政府側は、協議はまだ続いていると説明した。

輸出に依存するベトナムは、最大の輸出先である米国の懲罰的な関税回避に向けトランプ政権と１年以上にわたり協議を続けている。トランプ政権はかねて、ベトナムが中国製品の米国向け輸出の経由地と主張している。

トゥック氏は会合で、協定の最終文書を米国に送ったと明らかにし、「米国が、ベトナム製品が安定的かつ持続可能な形で米市場にアクセスできるよう、引き続き好ましい条件を整えることを期待する」と述べた。

一方、米商務省はフォーゲル次官補は、会合に寄せた録画メッセージで、両国が貿易協定に向けて協力を続けることを「期待している」と述べた。ジェニファー・ウィックス駐ベトナム米大使は同会合で、貿易協定の協議が続いていると改めて述べた。

フォーゲル氏は、米国の対ベトナム貿易赤字が、全ての貿易相手国の中で最大だと指摘し、貿易不均衡の解消に向け、ベトナム企業に対米投資を増やすよう求めた。

米国の最新の貿易統計によると、１─８月の対ベトナム貿易赤字は１６３０億ドルを超え、メキシコや中国を上回った。

同氏は、米国はベトナムに「世界最高水準の超知能（ＳＩ＝ＡＩ）ハードウエア」を輸出できるとも述べた。ベトナムは現在、米国の最先端技術の利用を制限されている。

ウィックス氏は、投資を呼び込み、企業が新しい技術を効率よく導入できるよう、データ保護の規制の枠組みを見直すようベトナムに求めた。さらに、成長するエネルギー部門に外国の投資を呼び込むために、予測可能な政策と、価格に関する安定したルールの整備を要望した。

item.title: Austrian court grants former property tycoon Benko's request for house arrest
item.description: An Austrian court on Wednesday granted former property tycoon Rene Benko's request to be released from prison to house arrest with an ankle monitor after he served two-thirds of a 30-month sentence for insolvency fraud.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Austrian court on Wednesday granted former property tycoon Rene Benko's [USN:L1N45Z0QM TEXT:"request"] to be released from prison to house arrest with an ankle monitor after he served two-thirds of a [USN:L1N45E0KA TEXT:"30-month sentence"] for insolvency fraud. Benko, 49, will now move from prison in his home city of Innsbruck to a roughly 60-square-metre (650-square-foot) apartment that his lawyer Norbert Wess has said has been rented for him in the city so he can better prepare for a fraud trial next month. Benko denies all wrongdoing. Benko has been convicted of insolvency-related fraud in the two cases brought to trial so far stemming from a [USN:L1N42K0I6 TEXT:"sprawling investigation"] into the collapse of the Signa property group he founded. The [USN:L1N3XG0BH TEXT:"second conviction"] resulted in a suspended sentence. He remains a suspect in the continuing investigation into a range of potential crimes including fraud, with prosecutors estimating the total harm caused by Benko and other suspects at €1.5 billion ($1.7 billion). His first two trials dealt with sums in the hundreds of thousands of euros. At its peak, Signa controlled all or part of luxury properties including five-star hotels in Venice and Vienna and the Chrysler Building in New York, as well as high-end department-store chains such as Britain's Selfridges and Switzerland's Globus. Benko became a self-made billionaire. "It was ordered that investigative detention be continued as electronically monitored house arrest," the court in Innsbruck said in a statement issued after the closed-door hearing on Wednesday, adding that conditions attached included having no contact with anyone related to Signa. The [USN:L1N42K0I6 TEXT:"next trial"] Benko faces is for aggravated fraud and insolvency-related fraud, with prosecutors accusing him of making a false guarantee causing harm of €5 million. The trial is due to be held in Innsbruck next month. ($1 = 0.8925 euros)

Stripchat loses legal fight against EU tech label

FAST

BRUSSELS, Oct 14 : Adult content platform Stripchat, a subsidiary of Cyprus's Technius, on Thursday lost its legal challenge against EU tech regulators' decision to include it in a list of companies subject to stringent requirements under landmark online content rules after Europe's second-highest court rejected its arguments, a court statement said. Three years ago, the European Commission designated Stripchat and two other adult content companies as very large online platforms under the Digital Services Act which requires such companies to do more to tackle illegal and harmful content on their platforms. DSA breaches can cost companies fines as much as 6 per cent of their global turnover. Stripchat subsequently sued the Commission, which is the EU tech enforcer, at the Luxembourg-based General Court. It disagreed with how the Commission calculated its number of users, a benchmark used to assess whether a company falls under the DSA. A court statement stated that the European Commission had given Stripchat adequate reasons for its decision.

item.title: Regierung beschließt Zuckersteuer auf Getränke ab Mitte 2027
item.description: Die Bundesregierung will die geplante Zuckersteuer auf Getränke deutlich abspecken und zugleich kleine Hersteller davon ausnehmen. Das Kabinett gab am Mittwoch grünes Licht für eine entsprechende Formulierungshilfe von Finanzminister Lars Klingbeil (SPD), die der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters vorliegt. Die Bundestagsfraktionen von Union und SPD sollen diese nun im Parlament beraten und umsetzen. Die neue Steuer soll am 1. Juli 2027 starten und helfen, die Kosten im Gesundheitssystem zu stabilisieren.
item.dc:creator: Christian Krämer, Holger Hansen
item.content:encoded: Die Bundesregierung will die geplante Zuckersteuer auf Getränke deutlich abspecken und zugleich kleine Hersteller davon ausnehmen. Das Kabinett gab am Mittwoch grünes Licht für eine entsprechende Formulierungshilfe von Finanzminister Lars Klingbeil (SPD), die der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters vorliegt. Die Bundestagsfraktionen von Union und SPD sollen diese nun im Parlament beraten und umsetzen. Die neue Steuer soll am 1. Juli 2027 starten und helfen, die Kosten im Gesundheitssystem zu stabilisieren. Der Grundgedanke dabei: Je höher der Zuckergehalt, desto höher soll auch die Steuerbelastung ausfallen. Nach der neuen Vorlage soll es aber nur noch zwei statt bislang geplanter drei Steuerstufen geben. Getränke mit fünf bis weniger als acht Gramm Zucker je 100 Milliliter sollen mit 26 Cent je Liter besteuert werden, ab acht Gramm werden 32 Cent fällig. In einer früheren Fassung waren noch 26 Cent ab fünf Gramm, 32 Cent ab sieben Gramm und 38 Cent ab zehn Gramm vorgesehen. Es sind Ausnahmeregelungen für kleine und unabhängige Hersteller mit einer jährlichen Produktionsmenge von bis zu 70.000 Litern vorgesehen. Zusätzlich wurde eine Befreiung für Betriebe bis eine Million Liter aufgenommen, wie das Finanzministerium mitteilte. Die staatliche Beihilfe muss allerdings die Europäische Kommission noch absegnen. Die Zuckersteuer soll zum Beispiel Cola-Getränke, Orangenlimonade, gesüßte Fruchtschorlen, Eistees und Energydrinks erfassen. Gleiches gilt für zuckerhaltigen Sirup. "Nicht erfasst werden alkoholhaltige Getränke, weil diese in der Regel bereits einer anderen Verbrauchsteuer unterliegen", so das Finanzministerium. Auch alkoholfreie Alternativen werden ausgenommen, ebenso wie reine Frucht- und Gemüsesäfte sowie ungesüßte Schorlen. CSU WILL SPÄTER STARTEN Durch die Änderungen sinken auch die erwarteten Einnahmen deutlich. Für 2027 rechnet der Bund bei voller Jahreswirkung mit 820 Millionen Euro, tatsächlich sollen wegen des Starts zur Jahresmitte 690 Millionen Euro in die Kasse fließen. Für 2031 werden Einnahmen von 890 Millionen Euro erwartet. Bisher waren noch Einnahmen von 925 Millionen Euro in der vollen Jahreswirkung für 2027 und 1,16 Milliarden Euro für 2031 veranschlagt worden. Die Einnahmen sollen genutzt werden, um eine geplante Kürzung des Bundeszuschusses an den Gesundheitsfonds zu verringern. Zudem soll die Abgabe zu einem gesünderen Konsum anregen. Laut Finanzministerium werden die jährlichen Versorgungskosten durch den erhöhten Konsum von gezuckerten Getränken für das Gesundheitssystem auf etwa 2,1 Milliarden Euro beziffert. Die CSU stört sich an der Einführung Mitte 2027. Der CSU-Landesgruppenchef im Bundestag, Alexander Hoffmann, sagte RTL, Anfang 2028 wäre besser. Dann hätten Unternehmen genug Zeit, die Rezepturen umzustellen. Entscheidend sei, den Betrieben ausreichend Vorlauf einzuräumen. "Wegen des rückläufigen Bierabsatzes setzen viele der 1400 Brauereien in Deutschland seit Jahren verstärkt auf alkoholfreie Getränke und bauen ihr Angebot aus - von Mineralwasser und Schorlen über Limonade und Cola bis hin zu Eistee und Kombucha", teilte der Deutsche Brauer-Bund mit. "Erfrischungsgetränke sind für viele unserer Betriebe zu einem zweiten Standbein geworden. Vor diesem Hintergrund beobachten wir die Steuerpläne mit großer Sorge und hoffen, dass es im parlamentarischen Verfahren noch zu Änderungen kommt." Die geplante Steuer sei eine massive Belastung für Verbraucher und Betriebe. Die Einnahmen lägen noch immer deutlich höher als von der Finanzkommission Gesundheit, einem Expertengremium, vorgeschlagen. "Nicht nur über die Zuckersteuer, auch zusätzlich über die Mehrwertsteuer würde der Staat jedes Jahr Hunderte Millionen mehr einnehmen als ursprünglich in der Koalition vereinbart."

item.title: Singapore pollution spikes, East Timor shuts schools as Indonesia wildfire haze intensifies
item.description: Pollution readings in Singapore reached their highest level this year on Wednesday while East Timor shut its schools for three days in response to intensifying smoke and haze from Indonesia's wildfires.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pollution readings in Singapore reached their highest level this year on Wednesday while East Timor shut its schools for three days in response to intensifying smoke and haze from Indonesia's wildfires. Singapore's 1-hour PM2.5 reading hit a high of 284 micrograms per cubic metre in the western part of the island state, entering the National Environmental Agency's "very high" band for the first time during the current haze period. The East Timor government said in a statement that it was suspending face-to-face learning activities for three days starting from October 15 "due to contamination by pollutant particles from wildfires in neighbouring regions or countries". East Timor did not identify Indonesia by name, but it shares an island with a part of Indonesia's East Nusa Tenggara province, where a number of hotspots have been reported. Indonesia has been battling its most intense wildfire season in 11 years, fueled by El Niño-related dry weather conditions. The haze has caused a spike in respiratory illnesses at home and a dramatic decline in air quality across the region, with several states in Malaysia also forced to [USN:L6N45V02L TEXT:"shut down schools"]. In October 2015, Indonesian wildfires brought PM2.5 levels in the west of Singapore up to a national record of 471 micrograms per cubic metre. 'TREAT THEM LIKE AN OUTCAST' Indonesia's President Prabowo Subianto has ordered additional resources to be deployed to combat the wildfires. "We are mobilising all our resources and capabilities," said Honi Havana, an official at the Coordinating Ministry for Political and Security Affairs, during a Wednesday press briefing. He said Jakarta has deployed more than 69,000 firefighting personnel, up from around 44,000 in mid-September, and it was also testing new methods to put out fires more effectively using special chemicals. Authorities have been struggling with peatland fires, which smoulder slowly beneath the surface and can re-emerge anytime, said disaster mitigation agency spokesperson Berton Panjaitan. "We must recognise that the only way to resolve this is through sustained rainfall," he said. As Southeast Asian foreign ministers prepare to discuss the issue of transboundary haze at an ASEAN meeting [USN:L6N45Z04F TEXT:"next month"], [USN:L6N45Z09S TEXT:"criticism"] of Indonesia has continued to mount across the region. On Tuesday, Malaysian lawmaker Syed Saddiq Syed Abdul Rahman called on Southeast Asian nations to lodge a diplomatic protest against Jakarta for failing to do enough to control the fires. "We must send a strong diplomatic note that Malaysia objects, and that not only Malaysia objects, it must be agreed upon by other ASEAN countries that are similarly affected, such as Singapore. We must send a very clear diplomatic protest," he told parliament. "You need to treat them like an outcast in the region," he said, adding that Malaysian and Singaporean banks should cut off financing to companies linked to land burning.

item.title: ＡＩ進歩と援助減少、先進国と途上国の格差拡大も＝ＩＭＦ専務理事
item.description:
Andrea Shalal David Lawder
[バンコク １４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andrea Shalal　David Lawder

[バンコク １４日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のゲオルギエワ専務理事は１４日、足元の経済情勢と人工知能（ＡＩ）の急速な進歩が、先進国と途上国の格差をさらに広げる恐れがあると警告した。開発援助の大幅な減少が、こうした懸念を特に強めていると述べた。

ＩＭＦは必要に応じて各国の資金調達を支える責任を認識していると述べた。その上で低所得国に低利・無利子融資を提供する「貧困削減・成長トラスト（ＰＲＧＴ）」への拠出を増やす約束を果たすよう加盟国に促した。

また「大災害抑制・救済基金（ＣＣＲＴ）」への資金補充も加盟国に求めていると述べた。ＣＣＲＴは最も貧しく脆弱な加盟国に対し、債務返済負担の軽減や債務免除に充てる無償資金を提供する。

先進国の金利上昇が新興国や低所得国に波及していると指摘。債務負担全体は軽減したものの、歳入に占める債務返済費用の割合は平均で１４％と、１０年前の６％から上昇したと述べた。

タイのバンコクで開かれているＩＭＦ・世界銀行年次総会に合わせた記者会見で「格差拡大のリスクが最も深刻なのは、既に大きく後れを取っている国々だ」と語った。こうした国々の多くは長年にわたり「懸命に努力」してきたにもかかわらず、燃料・食料価格の上昇、開発援助の減少、リスクの高い投資への意欲低下によって、圧力が一段と強まっていると指摘した。

新型コロナウイルスのパンデミック以降、財政余力の回復を最も怠ってきたのは米国などの先進国だと批判。一方、多くの途上国は制度の強化を通じて耐性を高めてきたと述べた。
